name: 73103 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73103 (Oklahoma City) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73103 (Oklahoma City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 73103 (Oklahoma City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
